scope: 0.10.1-claudegpt.27: hide threads from Reframe. 'Hide from Reframe…' (de: 'In Reframe ausblenden…') in the session list/history context menu, after a confirmation naming Settings › Hidden threads; disabled as '(end chat first)' while a Reframe-managed session runs. Keyed by claudeSessionId; state.json hiddenThreads (zod, default [] for older files) with label, cwd, distro and hiddenAt. A hidden thread is filtered by a Set lookup at discovery: registry scans (externalRunning, outsideClaudes: list, take-over, terminal window drops), transcript history, pinned items, project folders, Reframe's own ended records; recordFor and startOrTakeOver refuse it (no adoption, resume or take-over); notify skips it. Its process, registry entry and transcript are never touched; a hidden ended managed record is kept. Settings › Hidden threads lists label, folder and date with Restore and Restore all; restoring rescans at once (no restart). Unit tests for discovery filtering, persistence/migration and restore; e2e spec e2e/hidden-threads.spec.ts (not run locally).
